profile.visual_desc: Human female with floor-length pink hair. Wears a purple tunic under a heavy brown layered cloak featuring gold circular sigils. Adorned with thick gold wristbands and dark leg wraps.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Calm female face with brown eyes and purple lips. Voluminous pink hair is held by a delicate gold circlet with a central violet gem.
profile.weapon_desc: Dark metallic scepter with a bladed ornamental head, held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view facing ↖. Stands upright with staff held diagonally behind the right side.
profile.step2_windup: Spreads arms wide to gather energy, then lunges forward, bringing the staff into a horizontal thrusting position.
profile.step3_impact: Deep forward lunge. The staff tip emits a bright white-blue energy flare directed ↖ toward the target.
profile.step4_finish: Holds the extended lunge as the energy discharge fades. Hair and cloak billow forward from the momentum.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The energy burst in Frame 4 originates exactly from the staff's head, following the forward-tilting trajectory of the thrust.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation follows reference logic. Windup and thrust are consistent. VFX aligns with staff head. View remains stable.
